9700.construction:

asāra + to

examples.text: satthā ca me lokam'imaṃ adhiṭṭhahi, aniccato addhuvato asārato, pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahatā suduttarā.
sārañ'ca sārato ñatvā, asārañ'ca asārato, te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā.
virato methunā dhammā, hitvā kāme paropare, aviruddho asāratto, pāṇesu tasathāvare.

examples.text: asāre sāramatino, sāre ca-asāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.

saṃkiliṭṭhacitto nu kho bahulaṃ viharāmi, asaṃkiliṭṭhacitto nu kho bahulaṃ viharāmi, sāraddhakāyo nu kho bahulaṃ viharāmi, asāraddhakāyo nu kho bahulaṃ viharāmi

9716.meaning1: month of the lunar calendar; June-July

examples.text: anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro. pubbā koṭi nappaññāyati sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ
satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyyā'ti asiṃ vā sattiṃ vā bheṇḍiṃ vā laguḷaṃ vā pāsāṇaṃ vā satthaṃ vā visaṃ vā rajjuṃ vā.
brāhmaṇo evam'āha, ukkhipa kummaṃ, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti. abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa asisūnaṃ. asisūnā, bhadante'ti.

9719.commentary: (UDa) diṭṭho'sī'ti ayaṃ pana na pakatatto'ti bhagavatā diṭṭho asi.

examples.text: uṭṭhehi, āvuso, diṭṭho-asi bhagavatā, n'atthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso'ti
puriso ca te ukkhitta-asiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati. yatth'eva naṃ thokam'pi chaḍḍessati tatth'eva te siro pātessatī'ti.
sabbasaṅkhāresu ca me nibbidasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā bhavissati, seyyathā'pi ukkhitta-asike vadhake.

9721.commentary: (VINa) seyyathā'pi purāṇ'āsikoṭṭho'ti yathā nāma purāṇacammakāro'ti attho. yathā hi cammakāro cammaṃ vitthataṃ karissāmī'ti ito c'ito ca samañchati, kaḍḍhati, evaṃ so'pi taṃ nisīdanaṃ.

examples.text: kissa tvaṃ, udāyi, nisīdanaṃ samantato samañchasi, seyyathā'pi purāṇa-asikoṭṭho'ti?
atha āgaccheyya brāhmaṇakumāro asikkhito … atha āgaccheyya vessakumāro asikkhito … atha āgaccheyya suddakumāro asikkhito … na ca me attho tādisena purisenā'ti.

puna caparaṃ yadā devadatto rājā ahosi mahā mahīpati sabbakāmasamaṅgī, tadā bodhisatto tass'ūpabhogo ahosi hatthināgo sabbalakkhaṇasampanno, tassa cārugativilāsaṃ asahamāno rājā vadham'icchanto hatth'ācariyaṃ evam'avoca asikkhito te, ācariya, hatthināgo, tassa ākāsagamanaṃ nāma kāraṇaṃ karohī'ti

9723.meaning1: who has not completed the training
9723.commentary: (VIN) asikkhitasikkhā nāma sikkhā vā na dinnā hoti, dinnā vā sikkhā kupitā.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
asi ca cammañ'ca asicammaṃ, dhanu ca kalāpo ca dhanukalāpaṃ, hatthī ca asso ca hatthi-assaṃ, ratho ca pattiko ca rathapattikaṃ. evaṃ sen'aṅg'atthe.

addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.
asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī ahosiṃ.
anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.
taṃ buddhaṃ asitaṃ tādiṃ, akuhaṃ gaṇim'āgataṃ, bahūnam'idha baddhānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.

9730.grammar: masc, pp of na sayati, neg
9730.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.
pattalīmakulavaṇṇasādisā, sobhare su dantā pure mama, te jarāya khaṇḍitā ca-asitā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
tatr'idaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti asitabyābhaṅgiṃ, asitabyābhaṅgiñca pana suddo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopo'va adinnaṃ ādiyamāno'ti.

9735.meaning1: what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted; eating, drinking, chewing, and tasting
9735.compound: dvanda (asita ca pīta ca khāyita ca sāyita ca)
9735.commentary: (MNa) yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchatī'ti yena taṃ asitaṃ vā odan'ādi, pītaṃ vā pānak'ādi, khāyitaṃ vā piṭṭhakhajjak'ādi, sāyitaṃ vā ambapakkamadhuphāṇit'ādi sammā paripākaṃ gacchati, ras'ādi-bhāvena vivekaṃ gacchatī'ti attho. ayam'ettha saṅkhepo. vitthārato pana yaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, taṃ sabbaṃ saddhiṃ bhāvanānayena visuddhimagge vuttaṃ.

examples.text: asitapītakhāyitasāyitassa kho, nāgita, uccārapassāvo, eso tassa nissando.

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu.

9736.meaning1: classed as what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted

examples.text: imesu pana catūsu āhāresu asita-pīta-khāyita-sāyita-ppabhedo kabaḷīkāro āhāro'va imasmiṃ atthe āhāro'ti adhippeto. tasmiṃ āhāre paṭikkūl'ākāra-ggahaṇa-vasena uppannā saññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā.

9737.meaning1: scythe and flail; sickle and thresher

examples.text: tatr'idaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti asitabyābhaṅgiṃ, asitabyābhaṅgiñ'ca pana suddo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopo'va adinnaṃ ādiyamāno'ti.

9738.meaning2: sickle and carrying pole or flail

9739.commentary: (DNa) asit'ātigan'ti kāḷakabhāv'ātītaṃ candaṃ'va siriyā virocamānaṃ dasabalañ'ca dakkhema passissāmā'ti etadatthaṃ sabbe'pi te nām'anvayena āgacchuṃ, ye c'aññe sadisā sahāti.

examples.text: pavuṭṭhajātim'akhilaṃ, oghatiṇṇam'anāsavaṃ, dakkhem'oghataraṃ nāgaṃ, candaṃ'va asit'ātigaṃ.

9742.meaning1: sword-blade; sharp edge of a sword

examples.text: brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.

9744.meaning2: forest of trees with swords or knives for leaves
9744.commentary: (SNPa) asipattavanaṃ devadūte vuttanayam'eva. tañ'hi dūrato ramaṇīyaṃ ambavanaṃ viya dissati, ath'ettha lobhena nerayikā pavisanti, tato nesaṃ vāt'eritāni pattāni patitvā aṅgapaccaṅgāni chindanti. ten'āha, taṃ pavisanti samucchidagattā'ti.

examples.text: jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ārajay'ārajayā vihanantī'ti tattha asipattavane vegena dhāvitvā patitānaṃ musāvādīnaṃ nerayikānaṃ nirayapālā jivhaṃ baḷisena nikkaḍḍhitvā yathā manussā allacammaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pattharitvā khilehi ākoṭenti, evaṃ ākoṭetvā pharasūhi phāletvā phāletvā ekam'ekaṃ koṭiṃ chindetvā vihananti, chinnachinnā koṭi punappunaṃ samuṭṭhāti.

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā… maṃsapes'ūpamā… tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā… aṅgārakās'ūpamā… supinak'ūpamā… yācitak'ūpamā… rukkhaphal'ūpamā… asisūn'ūpamā… sattisūl'ūpamā… sappasir'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.

9758.commentary: (NIDD1) kiṃsū asissāmī'ti kiṃ bhuñjissāmi odanaṃ vā kummāsaṃ vā sattuṃ vā macchaṃ vā maṃsaṃ vā'ti, kiṃsū asissaṃ. kuva vā asissan'ti kattha bhuñjissāmi khattiyakule vā brāhmaṇakule vā vessakule vā suddakule vā'ti, kiṃsū asissaṃ kuva vā asissaṃ.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ asīsakaṃ kabandhaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ. tassa ure akkhīni c'eva honti mukhañ'ca.

9775.meaning1: not knocking the head; not bumping the head
9775.commentary: (VINa) vehāsakuṭi nāma majjhimassa purisassa asīsaghaṭṭā'ti yā pamāṇamajjhimassa purisassa sabbaheṭṭhimāhi tulāhi sīsaṃ na ghaṭṭeti

examples.text: vehāsakuṭi nāma majjhimassa purisassa asīsaghaṭṭā.

9776.grammar: pron, masc nom sg of amu

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca
taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi bhante gaṅgāya nadiyā mahā udakakkhandho so amunā loṇaphalena loṇo na assa apeyyo'ti.

9777.meaning1: such and such; this or that

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse saṅgho viharati sathero sapāmokkho. tassa me saṅghassa sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, ayaṃ dhammo, ayaṃ vinayo, idaṃ satthusāsanan'ti.

9778.meaning1: with such and such a brand

9779.meaning1: not white; not good; not positive

examples.text: idh'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. idha pan'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. idha pan'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.

atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇh'āsukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.

9780.meaning1: without ease; without comfort; not pleasant

examples.text: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
adukkham'asukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno adukkham'asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti

9781.meaning1: badly planted; badly sown; (comm) badly stored
9781.commentary: (DNa) asukhasayitānī'ti yāni sukkhāpetvā koṭṭhe ākiritvā ṭhapitāni, tāni sukhasayitāni nāma. etāni pana na tādisāni.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha dukkhette dubbhūme avihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhāpeyya khaṇḍāni pūtīni vāt'ātapahatāni asāradāni asukhasayitāni. devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asuciṃ saṅkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakamm'antaṃ asamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ
tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asuci visadoso apanīto saupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati
yathā pana aññe sattā mātukucchito nikkhamantā paṭikūlena asucinā makkhitā nikkhamanti, na evaṃ bodhisatto.

9784.meaning1: impure thing; something dirty; foul thing

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rāhula, pathaviyā sucim'pi nikkhipanti, asucim'pi nikkhipanti, gūthagatam'pi nikkhipanti, muttagatam'pi nikkhipanti, kheḷagatam'pi nikkhipanti, pubbagatam'pi nikkhipanti, lohitagatam'pi nikkhipanti, na ca tena pathavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.
kathañ'hi nāma tvaṃ, moghapurisa, hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocessasi!

9787.commentary: (SNa) asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti asuddh'aṭṭhena asuci, gāmavāsīnaṃ vijjhan'aṭṭhena kaṇṭako'ti gāmakaṇṭako.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ, ayañ'ca so āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti. taṃ kaṇṭako'ti iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo.

9788.grammar: adj, compar of na suci, neg
9788.construction:
na > a + √suc + i + tara
asuci + tara
9788.commentary: (MNa) asucitarāni c'evā'ti-ādīsu pakatiyā'va tāni asucīni ca duggandhāni ca pūtīni ca, idāni pana asucitarāni c'eva duggandhatarāni ca pūtitarāni ca honti.

examples.text: tathā tathā'ssa tāni vaṇamukhāni asucitarāni c'eva honti duggandhatarāni ca pūtikatarāni ca, hoti c'eva kāci sātamattā assādamattā, yadidaṃ vaṇamukhānaṃ kaṇḍūvanahetu.

9789.grammar: fem, abstr, from na suci, neg
9789.meaning1: impurity; uncleanliness; filthiness; foulness; fact of being disgusting
9789.construction:
na > a + √suc + i + tā
asuci + tā

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo asucinā kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, asucinā manokammena samannāgato hoti. idam'assa asucitāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi sā, bhikkhave, sivathikā asuci, tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.

9790.meaning1: tormented by impurity; afflicted with filth

examples.text: kasmā ca, doṇa, brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati? sace, doṇa, brāhmaṇo pāyamānaṃ gacchati, asucipaṭipīḷito nāma so hoti māṇavako vā māṇavikā vā. tasmā, doṇa, brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati.

9792.commentary: (SNa) asucī'ti na suci. saṅkassarasamācāro'ti imassa maññe imassa maññe idaṃ kamman'ti evaṃ parehi saṅkāya saritabbasamācāro. saṅkāya vā paresaṃ samācāraṃ saratī'ti'pi saṅkassarasamācāro. tassa hi dve tayo jane kathente disvā, mama dosaṃ maññe kathentī'ti tesaṃ samācāraṃ saṅkassara'ti dhāvatī'ti saṅkassarasamācāro.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhu, antopūtibhāvo? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.

9793.meaning1: considered to be filthy; regarded as foul
9793.commentary: (DNa) asucisaṅkhāto'ti asucikoṭṭhāsabhūto asucī'ti ñāto vā. (DNt) asucisaṅkhātaṃ asucibhāgataṃ attano sabhāvataṃ gato patto'ti asucisaṅkhāto'ti āha asucikoṭṭhāsabhūto'ti.

examples.text: asuci, bho kassapa, gūthakūpo asuci c'eva asucisaṅkhāto ca duggandho ca duggandhasaṅkhāto ca jeguccho ca jegucchasaṅkhāto ca paṭikūlo ca paṭikūlasaṅkhāto cā'ti

9796.meaning1: impurity which is criticized; filth which is blamed

examples.text: tass'ovādakarā bahugihī ca, pabbajitā ca asucivigarahita, panudipāpassa hi sucibhiparivuto, bhavati malakhilakakilese panudeti

na > a + √suc + i + ika
asuci + ika

9799.construction:
na > a + √suc + i + ika
asuci + ika

examples.text: ye idha kāmesu asaññatā janā, rasesu giddhā asucīkamissitā, n'atthikadiṭṭhī visamā durannayā, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.
